pages.quiz:
SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which day is celebrated on 16 June each year to honour children in Africa? (1 mark)
   A. Madaraka Day
   B. Labour Day
   C. Day of the African Child
   D. Jamhuri Day

2. Which word describes a picture that shows the four cardinal points? (1 mark)
   A. Compass rose
   B. Weather chart
   C. Rain gauge
   D. Timeline

3. In Figure 3 of the lesson, the sugar factory employs 7 hundred workers. How many workers is that? (1 mark)
   A. 70
   B. 7,000
   C. 7
   D. 700

4. Why are cardinal points better than left and right for giving directions? (1 mark)
   A. They are used only by pilots
   B. They are shorter to say
   C. They only work at night
   D. They do not change when you turn around

5. Why is a Children's Government important? (1 mark)
   A. It stops learning
   B. It gives pupils a voice and shares responsibility
   C. It punishes children
   D. It closes the school

6. What do we call a place where a river falls over a cliff? (1 mark)
   A. Waterfall
   B. Plain
   C. Valley
   D. Plateau

7. Lake Nakuru is famous for which birds? (1 mark)
   A. Flamingos
   B. Owls
   C. Ostriches
   D. Eagles

8. What is the first step in solving a conflict peacefully? (1 mark)
   A. Stop and calm down
   B. Run away
   C. Hit
   D. Shout

9. What is bullying? (1 mark)
   A. Sharing food
   B. Repeatedly hurting or frightening someone weaker
   C. Playing together
   D. Helping a friend

10. Which is an agro-based industry? (1 mark)
   A. A tea factory
   B. A bank
   C. A school
   D. A hotel

11. A tailor makes uniforms and a farmer buys them. What does the tailor need from the farmer? (1 mark)
   A. Food or money from selling food
   B. Cloth from the moon
   C. A tractor for sewing
   D. Nothing at all

12. What is income? (1 mark)
   A. Money borrowed
   B. Money received from selling
   C. Money lost
   D. Money spent

13. What is devolution? (1 mark)
   A. A kind of tax
   B. Keeping all power in one place
   C. Ending the government
   D. Sharing power and resources between the national and county governments

14. Who leads a location and is appointed by the national government? (1 mark)
   A. Village poet
   B. Clan elder
   C. Pastor
   D. Chief

15. Why do health workers depend on farmers? (1 mark)
   A. Farmers grow the food they eat
   B. Farmers keep records
   C. Farmers make medicine
   D. Farmers build hospitals

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Describe how a class can invite a resource person to talk about leadership. (4 marks)

17. Why do people trade? (2 marks)

18. Name four forms of child abuse. (4 marks)

19. Name two duties of a pupil in school. (2 marks)

20. State three reasons why Kenya has county governments. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Day of the African Child
   16 June is the Day of the African Child.

2. A — Compass rose
   A compass rose shows N, E, S and W.

3. D — 700
   7 hundreds = 700.

4. D — They do not change when you turn around
   Left and right change with the way you face, but north, east, south and west stay the same.

5. B — It gives pupils a voice and shares responsibility
   It teaches leadership and democracy.

6. A — Waterfall
   A waterfall is where a river drops over a steep edge.

7. A — Flamingos
   Lake Nakuru is well known for flamingos.

8. A — Stop and calm down
   We must calm down before talking.

9. B — Repeatedly hurting or frightening someone weaker
   Bullying is repeated unkind behaviour.

10. A — A tea factory
   Agro-based industries use farm produce.

11. A — Food or money from selling food
   The tailor depends on the farmer for food.

12. B — Money received from selling
   Income is what you receive from sales.

13. D — Sharing power and resources between the national and county governments
   Devolution moves some power to counties.

14. D — Chief
   A chief leads a location.

15. A — Farmers grow the food they eat
   Everyone needs food, including nurses and doctors.

SECTION B
----
16. (4 marks)
   Answer: Write a polite invitation, state the topic, give the date and time, and thank the visitor after the talk.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: People trade to get the goods they need but cannot make, and to earn money from the goods they produce.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

18. (4 marks)
   Answer: Early and forced marriage, female genital mutilation, child labour and child trafficking. Accept slavery, sexual abuse, abuse of children with special needs or unsafe transport.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each form.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: Follow the school rules and respect others. Accept care for property or do class duties.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each duty.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: To bring services closer to people, to let people take part in decisions, and to share development fairly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.
